llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam indicators: unrealistic profit claims (up to 98% daily wins, 3BTC/day), supposedly SEC registration and insurance without evidence, ambiguous business info, fake testimonials and fabricated withdrawal records, reference to hacking-related tools, misleading use of urgency and psychological tactics, use of Bitcoin as the main (untraceable) payment method, unverifiable company credentials, suspicious domain, and lack of transparency and regulatory compliance. All these clearly match key characteristics of investment scams.
